Fighter.name: Fighter
Fighter.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor. Fighters share an unparalleled mastery with weapons and armor, and a thorough knowledge of the skills of combat.

Resolve.description: Use an action to instantly heal.

Power Strike.description: A devastating attack that deals extra damage.

Wizard.name: Wizard
Wizard.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of spellcasting to suit their needs. Wizards live and die by their spells, learning to cast more and more powerful magic as they advance.

Cleric.name: Cleric
Cleric.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power. Clerics are intermediaries between the mortal world and the distant planes of the gods, healing allies and smiting foes.

Rogue.name: Rogue
Rogue.description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles. Rogues have many features in common, including their emphasis on perfecting their skills and their ability to strike with devastating precision.

Ranger.name: Ranger
Ranger.description: A warrior of the wilderness, skilled in tracking, survival, and combat. Rangers are protectors of the wild places of the world, using their knowledge of nature to hunt down threats.
